build_load_component: build a pipeline component by loading a model component from a given path using the appropriate transformer or diffusers library
create_component_loader: create a custom component loader subclass that registers itself for a specific component type with a target library
test_load_customized: test loading a customized component version before falling back to the native diffusers or transformers implementation
review_for_component_type: review the factory method that resolves the correct loader class for a given component name and library type
summarize_load_native: summarize how the native loader loads components from either transformers or diffusers with configurable revision and trust settings
